title: Monitoring of non-cigarette tobacco use using Google Trends

_pre_registration.authority: Proposed by the agent under the owner's standing delegation (second replication target requested by the coordinator); committed before any Google Trends request for this target.
_pre_registration.why_this_matters: A band chosen after seeing the result is not a band. Widening it later requires a new version of this file.

claims.notes: The paper reports r=0.39 (R-square 0.154, p=.018) between state 2011 Google Trends relative search volume for cigars and the 2011 YRBS prevalence of current cigar use among high-school students, 36 states. The band is the paper's own 95% confidence interval for r at n=36 (Fisher z: 0.0705 to 0.6369), rounded outward to [0.07, 0.64]: an observed r inside it is statistically consistent with the published estimate.

_not_registered.claim: adult cigar r=0.49 and adult smokeless r=0.48 (NSDUH 2010-2011)
_not_registered.reason: state prevalence came from the restricted-use NSDUH R-DAS; the state values are not in an open table
the open YRBSS dataset (data.cdc.gov svam-8dhg) has smokeless tobacco only from 2017; no open machine-readable 2011 state table was found
